# Grow Accrete

> D2C SEO & GEO Consultant for Shopify Brands, founded by Dhruv Sharma.

Grow Accrete helps direct-to-consumer (D2C) and Shopify brands scale organic revenue from Google and AI search engines like ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. Services are tailored for Shopify and e-commerce brands.

## Core Services

- Collection & Category Page SEO: Architecture, keyword mapping, conversion-focused collection copy, filter and faceted URL handling, and internal linking to rank for high-intent shopping queries.
- Product Page SEO: Title, description and image alt text optimisation, rich snippets (Product, Review, Offer schema), and Merchant Center free listings.
- Shopify Technical SEO: Eliminating duplicate URL structures, optimising Core Web Vitals and app bloat, crawl and indexation fixes, and multi-market and multi-currency store setups.
- Content That Sells: High-intent buying guides, "Best X for Y" comparisons, gifting and seasonal landing pages, and topical clusters connected to collections.
- Reddit & Community Mentions: Category research, authentic brand participation, and citation building where buyers ask for recommendations and LLMs source answers.
- CRO for Product & Collection Pages: Page-level UX and copy audits, trust signals, CTA placement, and revenue-prioritised test ideas.
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): Comprehensive AI visibility audits, LLM-ready catalogue feed and schema setups, brand citation strategies across ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Microsoft Copilot and Google AI Mode.

## Key Results

- GGT Foods: +195% organic revenue surge and +125% clicks growth in 6 months for a premium dry fruit brand.
- AllOfficials: +360% organic traffic surge and 447K+ interactions targeting high-intent e-commerce keywords.
- Tap Health: +190% organic traffic surge and 14,660+ conversions.
- BrandPOS: +352% click surge and Top 5 Google rankings.
- BlockP: +269% click growth and Top 5 international rankings.
